description: This file contains utility functions and class wrappers for Apache Spark's MLlib integration in PySpark, including serialization, Java-Python conversions, and JVM model handling.

classes.name: JavaModelWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for JVM models, enabling method calls and automatic detachment.

methods.name: _new_smart_decode
methods.description: Custom decoder to handle float('inf') and NaN in Py4j.

methods.name: _to_java_object_rdd
methods.description: Converts an RDD to a JavaRDD of objects via pickling.

methods.name: _py2java
methods.description: Converts Python objects to Java objects for Spark communication.

methods.name: _java2py
methods.description: Converts Java objects back to Python objects, handling RDDs, DataFrames, and serialized data.

methods.name: callJavaFunc
methods.description: Executes a Java function with converted arguments.

methods.name: callMLlibFunc
methods.description: Calls a specific MLlib API function in JVM from Python.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes JVM model wrapper, attaching to JVM model.

methods.name: __del__
methods.description: Detaches JVM model on garbage collection.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Calls a method on the JVM model.

methods.name: inherit_doc
methods.description: Decorator to inherit docstrings from parent classes.
